contractBoundary.statement: The operations and architecture elements in this document are exact proposed obligations for mrbaron3/workflow#15. They do not claim that the current base implements the revision-02 contract.
contractBoundary.browserAllowedNetworkBoundary: the exact configured same-origin loopback Control API only
forbiddenBrowserBoundaries: container runtime or Apple Container socket

canonicalOrigin.hostValidation: every dashboard and API request must match the configured Host exactly
canonicalOrigin.unsafeOriginValidation: Origin must equal the canonical origin byte-for-byte
canonicalOrigin.fetchMetadataValidation: unsafe methods require Sec-Fetch-Site compatible with same-origin

requirements: redirect to a clean URL before application assets load

securityHeaders: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
Cache-Control: no-store for bootstrap, session, and command data

truthContract.snapshotConsistency: mode, Registration identity/version, all five components, poll/delivery metrics, queue and active lease are returned from one consistent Registration-version-bound snapshot

execution.monitorOnlyRule: when desired is enabled, MONITOR_ONLY requires actual=paused_by_mode
execution.evidenceRule: ACTIVE values come only from authoritative job and runner evidence

truthfulnessRules: a successful query timestamp is not a component last-good timestamp
last-good is historical evidence and never paints a current failure healthy
missing or failed evidence is unknown, stale, failed, or disconnected, never inferred healthy
disconnect preserves prior data only as visibly last-known and disables mutation
recovery is announced only after a new authoritative successful snapshot

idempotency.scope: request-specific for create, update, disable, and retry

fences.create: repository uniqueness plus the idempotent initial Registration identity/version result
fences.update: If-Match with the observed positive Registration version
fences.disable: If-Match with the observed positive Registration version
fences.retry: observed route attempts plus current Registration identity/version

disableSafety: increments the Registration version exactly once
prevents leased old-version work from crossing the next critical side-effect fence
commandOutcomeContract.verificationRule: A 2xx response is command acceptance or applied evidence, not verified UI success. The UI must re-query the authoritative Registration or Delivery resource and match identity, version, desired fields, attempt identity, and resulting actual/recovery state.

architectureElements.meaning: Control API repeatable-read anomaly-first Registration status projection
Registration-version-bound supervisor for Issue Monitor, PR Monitor, and Forwarder
delivery retry and create idempotency lineage
durable delivery router and version-aware work convergence
loopback-only dashboard asset/bootstrap boundary; no browser access to PostgreSQL, providers, container runtime/socket, host filesystem, or non-Control-API hosts

server-side browser-session boundary with single-use script-free bootstrap, clean redirect, opaque HttpOnly cookie, exact Host/Origin, memory-only CSRF lifecycle, and zero bearer exposure to browser code
authoritative MONITOR_ONLY|ACTIVE and five-component desired/actual/freshness/last-good/error/recovery projection from a consistent Registration-version-bound snapshot
duplicate-safe structured command outcomes using Idempotency-Key, If-Match for update/disable, and observed attempts plus Registration version for retry
disable/version fencing and transactional audit that rejects queued old-version work and blocks leased old-version work at the next critical side-effect fence
authoritative recovery projection and post-command re-query verification; command acceptance is never UI completion

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: consume the one-time script-free bootstrap and redirect to a clean same-origin URL
return authenticated state, expiry, and the non-secret memory-only CSRF proof
logout and invalidate the opaque session and CSRF proof

uiInteractions: mutation disablement after expiry or rejection
capabilities.successSemantics: opaque server-side session established; expiry and CSRF proof available; clean URL loaded; no bearer exposure
failureSemantics: Host/Origin/fetch-metadata/CSRF mismatch fails closed before business input
expired or reused bootstrap creates no session
session/store failure shows rejected or disconnected and disables mutation
implementationObligations: loopback bind and one exact configured origin
single-use constant-time bootstrap validation and pre-asset clean redirect
server-side session store and cookie attributes
CSRF rotation/invalidation and security headers
retain bearer authentication only as a non-browser path
testEvidenceObligations: API matrix for exact Host and every rejected Origin variant
browser assertion that bearer is absent from HTML, JavaScript, DOM, URL, storage, logs, and payloads
CSP, no-store, no-CORS, frame and referrer header tests

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: return the anomaly-first, mode-aware, five-component authoritative snapshot

ownership.lineageNote: the #13 criteria remain lineage and do not substitute for #15 ownership

capabilities.successSemantics: one Registration-version-bound snapshot exposes exact mode and truthful desired/actual/freshness/last-good/error/recovery for all five components
failureSemantics: store disconnect returns no current truth and labels retained values last-known
stale/missing evidence remains stale or unknown
mode unavailable is unknown and never inferred
mutation remains disabled until a new authoritative successful snapshot
implementationObligations: extend the current projection with ARCH-registration-control-011
enforce the exact freshness budgets and component state domains
project durable queue depth and leased job/version
bind continuation to stable anomaly-first snapshot lineage
testEvidenceObligations: API schema and repeatable-read integration tests for all five components
MONITOR_ONLY paused_by_mode and ACTIVE evidence tests
Playwright anomaly order, empty, responsive matrix, and screen-reader label tests

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: create one Registration through strict input and duplicate-safe command outcome semantics

capabilities.successSemantics: applied or duplicate returns one identity and initial version; verified success waits for exact identity/version/desired-field re-query match
failureSemantics: invalid/unknown/unsafe fields are rejected without mutation
same repository conflict identifies the existing Registration
same key/different input is rejected
transport uncertainty is indeterminate, never success
implementationObligations: Idempotency-Key plus normalized request hash in the mutation transaction
structured outcome schema
strict allowlist with no arbitrary configuration
transactional actor/outcome audit
testEvidenceObligations: same-key same-input and same-key different-input API tests
restart persistence and re-query verification Playwright test

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: apply an allowlisted desired-state patch through idempotency and Registration-version fences

capabilities.successSemantics: one version increment for applied; duplicate returns the same new version; verified success waits for exact identity/version/all-desired-fields match
failureSemantics: stale If-Match is version_conflict with current version
same key/different patch or version is rejected
empty/unsafe patch is rejected
transport uncertainty remains indeterminate
implementationObligations: require Idempotency-Key and If-Match
persist normalized patch hash and structured outcome transactionally
return observed/current/result versions
never blind-retry version conflicts
testEvidenceObligations: duplicate transport retry without double increment
Playwright focus retention and verified re-query test

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: disable a Registration once and fence old-version work

uiInteractions: destructive confirmation with target and If-Match version
capabilities.successSemantics: one version increment and enabled=false; old queued work rejected and leased work blocked at the next side-effect fence; verified success waits for authoritative projection
failureSemantics: stale If-Match is version_conflict
same key/different input is rejected
already disabled returns current state without fabricating a new applied event
transport uncertainty remains indeterminate
implementationObligations: require Idempotency-Key and If-Match
transactionally audit actor/outcome and reject queued old-version work
enforce the leased-work critical side-effect fence
project old-work outcome and recovery
testEvidenceObligations: duplicate disable without double version/audit test
queued and leased old-version fence integration tests
restart persistence and Playwright verification-state test

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: return the authoritative delivery, attempt, Registration binding, and recovery projection

capabilities.successSemantics: one durable snapshot returns delivery state, attempts, Registration identity/version, and recovery evidence
failureSemantics: not found and unauthorized are not empty success
disconnect leaves only visibly last-known detail and disables retry
pending remains pending until authoritative evidence changes
implementationObligations: extend delivery response with verification and recovery fields
return bounded non-secret attempt history
make delivery/attempt/Registration binding snapshot-consistent
testEvidenceObligations: no webhook payload or secret leakage test

plannedHttpOperations.purpose: create at most one retry attempt through delivery-attempt and Registration-version fences

uiInteractions: authoritative delivery and Registration re-query verification
capabilities.successSemantics: applied or duplicate returns one attempt identity and bound Registration version; 202 remains pending evidence until delivery re-query verifies the durable result
failureSemantics: route-attempt or Registration-version mismatch is version_conflict
disabled/missing/unsafe Registration is rejected with a durable reason
same key/different delivery/attempt/version input is rejected
transport uncertainty remains indeterminate and permits only same-key same-input replay
implementationObligations: require Idempotency-Key, observed route attempts, and current Registration identity/version
lock and revalidate delivery and Registration fences
persist accepted and rejected attempt outcomes transactionally
return structured outcome and cancellable=false
verify through ARCH-registration-control-014

coverageSummary.implementationGate: requires a separate Human Design Decision approving the exact revisionId and bundleDigest; this reconciliation alone is not approval
